name: Scenario: 1. Full close publishes finalized lifecycle snapshot with all fields
Scenario: 2. Flip publishes close for old direction and resets accumulators on the new lifecycle
Scenario: 3a. Partial reduce does not publish a close and accumulates closed volume
Scenario: 3b. Multiple partial reduces at different prices show uniform base increments but varying quote increments
Scenario: 4a. Pre-cumulative positions are excluded from close publications
Scenario: 4b. Positions opened with both flags on DO produce close publications
Scenario: 4c. Cumulative-data ON but position-history OFF: baseline fields update, history fields stay zero, no close pub
Scenario: 5. Liquidation close publishes LIQUIDATED status with close mark price and full fields
Scenario: 6. Multi-partial-close then full close aggregates all lifecycle data
Scenario: 7. Positions opened before the history flag do not emit close pubs
Scenario: 8. Isolated full close publishes margin_type isolated with correct leverage
Scenario: 9. Isolated partial reduce accumulates closed volume alongside auto-rebalance
Scenario: 10. Isolated flip publishes close for old lifecycle, resets accumulators on new lifecycle
Scenario: 11. Isolated liquidation publishes LIQUIDATED status with margin_type isolated
